headlines.text: 2026 brought us this moment: Willow Nightingale vs. Hikaru Shida went to battle over the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.17. It marked Willow Nightingale's 10th match with the title on the line. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
2025 brought us this moment: Marina Shafir returned to the fold after a long-awaited absence after just over 15 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
On a Wednesday in 2025, back when Knight & Ospreay arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.63.

secondaries.text: It was 2026 when Knight & Mistico announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.79.
On this day in 2026, Andrade & Davis made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.64.
Rewind to 2025, when Cope vs. Claudio Castagnoli met for the very first time, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 6.03.
